formal_role: Defines the starting value before interval accumulation begins
systems_modeling_role: Keeps inherited burden separate from new accumulated change
review_warning: Omitting the initial stock can make ending-stock claims misleading

formal_role: Defines the rate of stock change as inflow minus outflow
systems_modeling_role: Explains why the stock grows declines or stabilizes

formal_role: Records cumulative inflow and cumulative outflow separately
systems_modeling_role: Prevents large offsetting activity from being hidden by net change
review_warning: Net change alone can conceal high stress or turnover

formal_role: Defines the interval over which exposure is accumulated
systems_modeling_role: Clarifies whether the result is event-based annual lifetime or moving-window exposure
review_warning: Changing the window changes the cumulative claim

formal_role: Checks that rate multiplied by time produces stock or exposure units
systems_modeling_role: Prevents flow stock concentration and exposure from being confused
review_warning: Unit mismatch indicates an invalid cumulative interpretation
